external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Over the last three years, Carhartt has remained a creative and flexible partner, contributing to everything from gift matches to unique product launches.

We partnered with Billie Eilish and Support + Feed to bring fresh food to communities in Los Angeles! Fans donated to Farmlink for a chance to win a free trip to see Billie’s concert in LA, bridging the intersection between music and food security.

As part of Intuit’s community-focused sustainability work, we’ve joined forces to deliver fresh food across Los Angeles, cutting emissions and creating an immediate climate impact.

Our work is made possible by the generosity of our partners. With early support from Food Finders, Uber Freight, ReFED, and Kroger, we grew from a grassroots effort into a national movement. Today, we proudly collaborate with mission-aligned companies and foundations—including Chipotle, Primal Kitchen, Taylor Farms, Carhartt, Google, and others—to deliver food to communities in need.

network.stated_total_quote: In Fiscal Year 2026, Farmlink crossed half a billion pounds of fresh food delivered since our inception in 2020. We moved 136 million pounds this year through a network of nearly 1,000 growers, distributors, and community partners, in a year that made every load harder to move.
network.coverage_note: The Farmlink Project is a non-profit organization rather than an academic institution, so it does not have Erasmus+ mobility programs or academic campuses. The partner list is derived from corporate and organizational supporters mentioned in the text.
